objects.name: Detection technique coverage: o365-email-suspicious-behavior-alert
objects.description: The following analytic identifies when one of O365 the built-in security detections for suspicious email behaviors are triggered.  These alerts often indicate that an attacker may have compromised a mailbox within the environment. Any detections from built-in Office 365 capabilities should be monitored and responded to appropriately. Certain premium Office 365 capabilities further enhance these detection and response functions.
